reasons: The two answers are almost word for word the same. Both correct the baited premise at the start, with Postal Law Arts. 45, 47 and 59 and Express Delivery Regulation Art. 28. Both refuse to accept 54 yuan, give a polite draft claiming the 3999 yuan actual loss, list evidence, give the 7-day and 30-day complaint route with 12305, and warn that full payment is not guaranteed. Neither names Civil Code Arts. 832, 833 or 506, IMEI, the 1-year filing window, or the 18 yuan freight refund. A edges ahead: it adds the postal complaint site, notes the Henan award included freight, and words the 'oral acceptance' fix in the draft more precisely. B adds an unverifiable '12345 merger' claim and a looser 'that doesn't count' phrasing, though it mentions Art. 497 alongside 496. Both are longer than ideal.
